question: What does the autodefrag mount option do and for which workload is it unsuitable?
statement: The autodefrag option turns on automatic file defragmentation; when enabled, it detects random writes to files in a tens-of-kilobytes range (currently 64 KiB) and queues them. Large database workloads may be a poor fit; reading adjacent blocks may raise read latency, while successive writes merge blocks at the new location.
quote: detected and queued up for the defragmentation process.
